user.title: Connect your Matterbase inventory
user.description: Run the Matterbase Docker service first, then enter its URL. The address must be reachable from Home Assistant and your browser. Configure MATTERBASE_FRAME_ANCESTORS on the service to allow your Home Assistant URL. This installs a sidebar connector, not the OCR server; it does not create entities or pair devices.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP(S) URL without credentials, query parameters, or fragments.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach a healthy Matterbase server. Check the URL, network access, HTTPS certificate, and that its container is running.
error.embedding_disabled: The server blocks embedding. Set MATTERBASE_FRAME_ANCESTORS to your Home Assistant browser URL, then redeploy Matterbase and try again.
